params.body:
Nightwatch #36: a 500 on `ownvehicle/22992/createFromVIN` for a dealer using "aanvullen via chassisnummer", 22 September at 12:50.

```
Error: Call to a member function except_dealers() on null
  app/Services/OwnStockService.php:603
```

The id in that request did not exist at the time. On production, vehicle 22992 was created at 14:50, two hours later.

## Two things had to go wrong together

`tempupdate` looked the vehicle up, did not check the result, and broke three steps further on a null reference.

And the `try { … } catch (\Exception $e)` around it, which exists to show a failed lookup as a field error next to the chassis number, does not catch an `\Error`. So the dealer got a white page where "Het gezochte voertuig werd niet gevonden" belonged.

Both are fixed: the lookup stops at the front with that message, and the three lookup paths catch `\Throwable`. Two of those three calls were outside any `try` at all, so a vanished vehicle became a 500 there anyway, right after the first path had produced the polite message.

## And a dead branch removed

```php
if (isset($afterUpdateData['portal_ids']) && is_null($afterUpdateData['portal_ids'])) {
    $vehicle->portals()->sync(...);
}
```

Those two can never both be true: `isset()` is false for null. That sync has never run. PHPStan knew — the entry was sitting in the baseline as "Right side of && is always false" — and the baseline entry goes with the code.

It is removed, not repaired. Making it run would mean a chassis lookup starts setting portals from today, and that is a decision for Ilse, not a clean-up. The two live paths, `finalizeCreate` and `finalizeEdit`, do sync portals, with the VAT filter of R S2-4.9.

## Verified

`AVinLookupWithoutAVehicleIsAMessageTest` holds both halves: the service throws a readable message instead of an `Error`, and no call to `tempupdate` sits without a `catch (\Throwable)` near it.

Full suite locally: 2.111 tests, 12.277 assertions, with only the two known `ListPageHeadersTest` cases failing, which fail the same way without this change because those tables are empty in my local database. `phpstan` green over the whole project with one baseline entry fewer; `pint` green on the added file.

Fixes bevinding aanvullen-via-chassis-zonder-wagen.
params.title: A chassis lookup without a vehicle is a message, not a 500
